description:
Accept one pending application and make a hire; the worker is paid later. An already-funded spot accepts hosted sign-in; paying for a spot requires an API key. If the applicant proposed another price, accepting charges that price without confirmation.
Use for: hiring one applicant of your bounty.
Not for: paying a worker (pay_hire); ending a hire (cancel_hire).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: accept_application({"applicationId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc"})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: spots_full, wallet_short, payment_page_open, held_pay_not_shown, payment_processing, charge_mismatch, payment_needs_attention, spot_not_paid_for, application_not_pending, application_changed, bounty_not_open, accept_in_progress, check_not_passed, applicant_unavailable, account_frozen, spending_limit_reached, account_setup_required; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

message.description: A note the applicant reads with the acceptance. Markup, script links and outer spaces are removed before it is stored, so the applicant may read fewer characters than you sent. Only when money is already held for the spot; a bounty paid per hire, or a spot this call pays for from your wallet, refuses it. Default: no note.

name: accept_application

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks.

open.description: Spots today's rules let you hire into right now. 0 on a paused or ended bounty and on a draft you still have to fund with fund_bounty; a draft that is paid for another way shows its open count.

payLater.description: How many of total are not paid for up front. You pay a worker in one when the work is done. Only the platform adds these.

total.description: Every spot you can hire into: paid up front plus pay-later.

cost.description: What this hire costs you as its held money stands now: pay plus service fee. Left out when nothing is held: the fee of a pay-later hire is set when you pay.

at.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

hireId.description: The hire that exists for this application now; read it with get_hire. It is not a receipt that this call made it: an earlier call, or a payment arriving, may have.

status.description: offered: waiting for the worker to confirm. active: working, or fixing a redo. submitted: work waits for your review, or the work is done and its pay waits for you to release or pay it. paid: the pay was released to the worker. disputed: the money is held until the platform settles it. ended: the hire is over without pay, see endedReason.

title: Accept an application
